author: Gerald Teschl
title: Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems
version: Author-hosted preliminary version made available with AMS permission; locators refer to this downloaded copy
supports: Analytic normal-form ODEs have locally unique analytic solution germs; vector system set up on page111
does_not_support: No computed radius, global solution, full bed model or certified numerical remainder for our data
reading_summary: Section 4.1 sets up analytic vector ODEs, relates analyticity to convergent local power series, and proves local existence and uniqueness by analytic Picard iteration. A bounded complex neighborhood supplies a radius estimate only after its bounds are established; our code does not calculate those bounds.
distribution_note: The downloaded book is kept only in ignored local build scratch; this receipt contains metadata and a paraphrase, not a redistributed PDF.
